# RezzoBot — ATS Resume Optimizer

## About
RezzoBot is an ATS resume checking tool that analyzes your resume against job descriptions, identifies missing keywords, and provides optimization suggestions without rewriting your content.

## Key pages
- https://rezzobot.com — Homepage, resume upload, ATS score
- https://rezzobot.com/blog — Blog with ATS tips and guides
- https://rezzobot.com/pricing — Pricing: Free analysis, $4.99 single, $14.99/mo
